body.name: \(\mathfrak Q_{T,L}\)
body.construction: Handle: generalize the explicit common-null architecture in \(\mathcal Q_8\) by randomizing block offsets at length \(L\) and adding arm-specific positive-part band transports at every \(b\in\mathcal B_T\) with \(b\le L\); then derive a single occupancy--information inequality under the common-null path law. Every prior is fixed before assignment, and no member is selected from the realized path.
